ACT I: THE INCITING INCIDENT

EXT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS — DAY
The campus buzzes. Students begin new lives.
Kan walks, a freshman.
He feels eager. He belongs.
He catches up.
His wallet disappears.
It held cash and his only connection home.
His friend calls. Strangers send a message.
They claim they have his wallet.
A phone number passes to Kan.
Kan is new. He does not know the streets.
He needs the money. He acts.
He calls the number after lectures.
A voice tells him to come outside the school.
He must collect it at 5 p.m.

EXT. OUTSIDE SCHOOL PREMISES — LATE AFTERNOON
Kan arrives at the meeting point.
He finds a group.
More than seven men are there.
They sit and drink casually.
They wave him over and beckon him to join.
Kan takes a seat among them.
They tell him to drink with them.
Kan tries to refuse.
The mood shifts.
He cannot refuse.
Kan drinks.
Kan observes the men.
Kan does not know this.
One man at the table is the group's serving executioner.
The title, and the role, carry real weight.
The man is EMK.
Other rough men drift by.
They greet the group.
They greet EMK specifically with both hands.
This gesture signals status.
It hints at fear.
Kan grows restless.
He wants to leave.
EMK's demeanor changes.
He acts almost fatherly.
He asks Kan about his studies.
EMK gives Kan his personal number.
He tells Kan to call if he runs into trouble.
Kan leaves the group.
He feels relief, happy to have his wallet back.
EMK's number is in his pocket.
The number connects him to the Viking Confraternity, tying his new life on campus to theirs.
FADE OUT.
